CSS properties ​

Every property TCSS accepts. An unknown property, or a value outside its list, is V003. A document without version accepts all of them; the notes say what an older version="1" or version="2" document leaves out. Sizes are N cells, N% of the parent, Nfr shares of what is left, or auto. Colors are a $token (or var(--token)), one of the 16 ANSI names, #rgb, #rrggbb, or default. See TCSS and Layout for how they combine.
